summary: Navy Trust visual redesign — frontend-only regression validated end-to-end via Playwright on public preview URL. Landing, Login, Buyer Dashboard, Vendor Dashboard, Vendor KPI, Admin (Orgs/SBD/Audit), Tender Detail, and Create Tender all render cleanly with the new palette (#0f1b3d navy / #3b6fa0 navy-soft / #e8edf3 pale), Libre Baskerville display serif, IBM Plex mono, sharp corners, and rounded pills. Every previously-defined data-testid still resolves. Frontend compiles clean (Compiled successfully! — no ESLint warnings in latest tail). Only issue found is a minor data-mapping bug on the new Landing live-stats card: it reads stats.vendors_total but /api/public/stats actually returns vendors_approved, so the 'Vetted Vendors' stat renders '—' instead of 36.

ui_bugs.issue: Reads stats.vendors_total which does not exist in /api/public/stats response. API returns {tenders_open:78, vendors_approved:36, total_tenders:100}. Result: 'Vetted Vendors' always displays em-dash '—' even though 36 vendors are approved. One-line fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx L96: change stats?.vendors_total to stats?.vendors_approved.

Recommend future test scripts use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + explicit selector waits (as done in iter11). Not an app bug — SSE is intentional.

No console errors beyond the known Emergent-devtools <option> hydration warning + expected 401s on /api/auth/me before login.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Navy Trust redesign is visually complete and all data-testids resolve. Only functional bug is Landing.jsx L96 vendors_total→vendors_approved. If retesting after fix, look at [data-testid=stat-vendors] — should now show 36 instead of '—'. When writing Playwright tests, always use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + explicit selector waits — never 'networkidle' — because the SSE tender-feed stream keeps the network active permanently. Backend has not been re-tested this iteration; iter 10 covered 28/28 P2 tests. If backend logic changes are made in the future, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_p2_green_orange.py with `pytest -n 0`.
rca of the issue: Landing.jsx stat-vendors bug — during the redesign the developer wrote value={stats?.vendors_total ?? '—'} but the /api/public/stats endpoint returns the key `vendors_approved`. The nullish-coalescing operator masked the undefined result so no runtime error was thrown. Reproduction: open https://tender-hub-57.preview.emergentagent.com/ → the middle row of the live-stats card labeled 'Vetted Vendors' shows em-dash '—' instead of a number. curl https://tender-hub-57.preview.emergentagent.com/api/public/stats confirms the correct key is `vendors_approved` = 36. Mitigation: sed 's/vendors_total/vendors_approved/' in Landing.jsx L96, hot-reload picks it up.
